_comment: Pinned FFmpeg sidecar binaries for the Tauri client (apps/client).
scripts/provision-ffmpeg.mjs verifies the on-disk sidecar against sha256 + bytes
(FAIL-CLOSED on mismatch) and can download+verify when a real 'url' is pinned.
Windows sha256/bytes/version are REAL, measured from the committed build.
macOS/Linux entries are intentionally ABSENT: adding a fabricated hash would be a
fake-green (No-Fake-Success). The script fails EXPLICITLY for any triple not listed.
Byte delivery for a fresh clone is a repo-owner decision: either (a) commit the
binary via Git LFS, or (b) set a real immutable 'url' (whose artifact hashes to the
pinned sha256). Until then a fresh checkout without the binary fails closed, honestly.
